Class ValidationUtils

  • Method Details

    • isValidEmail

      public static boolean isValidEmail(String email)
      Validates an email address. Rules: - Must not be null or blank - Must contain username, '@', and valid domain with TLD of at least 2 characters - Must not have consecutive dots or start/end with dot in username or domain
      Parameters:
      email - the email to validate
      Returns:
      true if valid, false otherwise

    • isValidPassword

      public static boolean isValidPassword(String password)
      Validates password strength according to standard security rules. Rules: - Minimum 8 characters, maximum 64 characters - At least one uppercase letter (A-Z) - At least one lowercase letter (a-z) - At least one numeric digit (0-9) - At least one special symbol from: !@#$%^invalid input: '&'*()-_+=[]{}|;:',.invalid input: '<'>?/ - Must not contain any whitespace characters
      Parameters:
      password - the password to check
      Returns:
      true if password meets all complexity rules, false otherwise

    • isValidPhoneNumber

      public static boolean isValidPhoneNumber(String phone)
      Validates a phone number. Rules: - Must not be null or blank - Stripped digits count must be between 7 and 15 (E.164 standard) - May include an optional leading '+' and separators (dashes, spaces, dots, parentheses)
      Parameters:
      phone - the phone number string
      Returns:
      true if valid, false otherwise

    • isValidPostalCode

      public static boolean isValidPostalCode(String postalCode, String countryCode)
      Validates postal code format by country code. Supported countries: - "US": 5 digits or 5 digits followed by hyphen and 4 digits (e.g. "90210" or "90210-1234") - "UK" / "GB": standard UK outward and inward code (e.g. "SW1A 1AA", "W1A 0AX") - "AM": Armenia 4 numeric digits (e.g. "0010") - "CA": Canada alphanumeric A1A 1A1 (e.g. "K1A 0B1") - Any other country: 3 to 10 alphanumeric characters
      Parameters:
      postalCode - the postal code
      countryCode - 2-letter ISO country code (case-insensitive)
      Returns:
      true if postal code matches country format, false otherwise

    • isValidIpAddress

      public static boolean isValidIpAddress(String ip)
      Validates an IPv4 address. Must consist of 4 decimal octets (0-255) separated by dots, no leading zeros unless single '0'.
      Parameters:
      ip - the IP address string
      Returns:
      true if valid IPv4, false otherwise

    • sanitizeInput

      public static String sanitizeInput(String input)
      Sanitizes user input to prevent HTML/XSS injection. Converts: - 'invalid input: '&'' -> '&' - 'invalid input: '<'' -> '<' - '>' -> '>' - '"' -> '"' - '\'' -> '''
      Parameters:
      input - the raw string
      Returns:
      sanitized string, or empty string if input was null
